subject: Security & VPC follow-up: SOC 2 / GDPR / deployment options for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>, Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Requirements we heard: private VPC deployment with strict network isolation, SOC 2 Type II evidence, GDPR data residency controls, and a vendor security questionnaire (see note below).
- Questions we promised to confirm: whether you need air-gapped on-prem option vs VPC with limited outbound egress, and specifics on logging/retention for audit.

Proposed next steps: 
1) We can share our SOC 2 report and standard deployment diagram — I will loop in security and CS to produce a draft diagram for your review (ETA: 48 hours).
2) Please send over the vendor security questionnaire (if you want us to populate it, we can take a pass and return a redlined copy).
3) If you need an on-prem/air-gapped option, let us know the expected timeline and physical constraints so we can scope it.

I'm copying Monica (CS lead) and Jasmine (security) to own artifacts.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today

Thanks Marcus — great summary. A few clarifications: 

- We're leaning toward a VPC deployment in our AWS account with very restrictive egress (mostly to S3 for logs) rather than full air-gap, but we may require an on-prem option for a subset of data flows.
- GDPR: we need data residency in AWS us-east-1 and evidence of processors/sub-processors.
- I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire; can you have your security team complete and return? We'd like answers back within 10 business days to keep procurement on schedule.

Also please send over your SOC 2 Type II report link and a draft deployment diagram for our network/security team to review.

Attachments: acme_vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx

Sara Thompson
Head of Security, Acme Corp
sara.thompson@acmecorp.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>, Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today

Sara — thanks, got the questionnaire. Looping in Jasmine (Security) to coordinate the questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence, and Monica (CS) to draft the VPC deployment diagram with the network isolation options (us-east-1 residency).

Jasmine / Monica: can you take point on these deliverables? Suggested owners and ETA: 
- Jasmine: populate the vendor security questionnaire and include SOC 2 Type II link + subprocessors list (ETA: 5 business days)
- Monica: draft two deployment diagrams — (1) VPC-hosted in Acme AWS with restricted egress + S3 logging, (2) isolated on-prem package notes (ETA: 48 hours)

We'll aim to return the questionnaire and SOC 2 link in a single packet so Acme can feed to procurement. Any constraints or questions let me know.




— Marcus

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-26T15:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security / VPC follow-up (SOC 2, GDPR, deployment diagrams)

Hi all — I'm picking this up from security. Quick notes: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for 2025; I've placed the access link in the attachments list and will provide a signed cover letter if procurement needs it. Our subprocessors and data handling practices will be included in the questionnaire responses.
- GDPR/data residency: we support region pinning; for Acme we can target us-east-1 for storage and processing. We maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) and Data Processing Agreements; I can include references in the questionnaire.
- On-prem/air-gap: we support an on-prem package but it requires a project-level engagement (lift-and-shift, hardware procurement, and runbook for offline model updates). I've included a short note in the draft deployment diagram about constraints.

Attaching: acme_redwood_deploy_diagram_draft.pdf (draft), redwood_soc2_report_2025_link.txt (link to SOC 2 evidence). Will start filling the questionnaire and return a redline by next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acmecorp.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-27T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps & delivery plan

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary of what we'll deliver by next Wednesday (2026-04-01): 

- Completed vendor security questionnaire (Jasmine)
- SOC 2 Type II report link + signed cover letter if requested (Jasmine)
- Draft VPC deployment diagram and short on-prem notes (Monica)
- Statement of work estimate for on-prem/air-gapped option (if you confirm you want scope)

Please confirm the 10-business-day procurement target still holds on your side. If so, we'll prioritize the questionnaire responses first.

If you need us to run a short tech deep-dive with your network team, Monica can set up a 30-minute session after you review the draft diagram.
\Best,
Marcus

Attachments: redwood_soc2_report_2025_link.txt, acme_redwood_deploy_diagram_draft.pdf
